CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
March 24, 2026 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Javier Toyos, La Mirada Church of The Nazarene
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Historical Preservation Advisory Council
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember Bean
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF LOVE LA MIRADA'S NEIGHBORHOOD HEROES - It is recommended the City Council present Bruce Dixon, Oscar Duarte, Jackie Galindo-Avila, Chris and Desiree Johnson, Ricky Ostendi, Adriana Spirescu, Greg Stump, and Matt Wight with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
5.1 Love La Mirada Heroes Recognition
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of March 10, 2026, the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of March 10, 2026, and the minutes of the special City Council meeting of March 17, 2026.
7.1 Study Session Minutes
7.1 City Council Minutes
7.1 Special City Council Meeting
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 24, 2026 in the total amount of $4,048,749.51.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING FEBRUARY 2026 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending February 2026.
7.3 Investment Report - February
7.4
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING JANUARY 2026 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending January 2026.
7.4 Treasurer Report - January
7.5
AGREEMENT WITH WILDAN FINANCIAL SERVICES TO PROVIDE DISCLOSURE AND ARBITRAGE SERVICES – It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with Wildan Financial Services for disclosure and arbitrage services and authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement on behalf of the City.
7.5 Agreement with Wildan Financial Svcs.
7.6
CITY COUNCIL REQUEST FOR CONFERENCE ATTENDANCE – It is recommended the City Council approve Councilmember Bean’s request to attend the California Contract Cities Association’s 2026 Annual Municipal Seminar.
7.6 City Council Conference Request
7.7
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE PUBLIC WORKS VEHICLES – It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of two Chevrolet Silverado EV 4WD WT trucks from Selman Chevrolet in the amount of $49,608.85 per truck, for a total cost of $99,217.70.
7.7 Authorization to Purchase Vehicles
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2025-04, WINDERMERE AND GARDENHILL PARKS COMMUNITY BUILDINGS FLOORING REPLACEMENT AND INTERIOR PAINTING - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT – It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2025-04, Windermere and Gardenhill Parks Community Buildings Flooring Replacement and Interior Painting, to Lawrence W. Rosine Co. in the amount of $64,438; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project construction cost.
7.8 CIP No. 2025-04 Flooring and Interior Painting
7.9
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2025-05, SPLASH! LA MIRADA HEATER REPLACEMENT – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT – It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2025-05, Splash! La Mirada Heater Replacement, to California Waters Development Inc. dba California Waters in the amount of $578,616; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve amendments to the on-call consulting services agreements for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the construction contract cost.
7.9 CIP No. 2025-05, Splash! Heater Replacement
7.10
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2025-06, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 7 – FINDING THAT PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT OF 1970, THE PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT UNDER SECTION 15301 CLASS 1 (C) AND APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS – It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2025-06, Neighborhood Slurry Seal Area 7; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.10 CIP No. 2025-06 Neighborhood Slurry Seal
7.11
CITY CAMERA SYSTEM UPDATE – AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES – It is recommended the City Council award the contract to Exante360 to provide consulting services as required to prepare performance specifications and provide peer review services for the improvements to update and expand the existing camera system infrastructure in the amount of $32,890; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract with Exante360; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the contract cost.
7.11 City Camera System
7.12
DRONE LIGHT SHOW FOR AMERICA’S 250TH PATRIOTIC CONCERT – AWARD OF CONTRACT – It is recommended the City Council award the contract to Open Sky Productions, LLC to provide a drone light show for America’s 250th Patriotic concert in the amount of $31,500; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract with Open Sky Productions, LLC; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the contract cost.
7.12 Drone Light Show
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-10 ADOPTING A PROJECT LIST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-27 FUNDED BY SB-1: THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-10 adopting a project list for Fiscal Year 2026-27 funded by SB-1 and authorizing staff to submit the project list to the California Transportation Commission.
8.1 Resolution No. 26-10 SB-1
8.2
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 749 AMENDING SECTION 10.12.020 OF CHAPTER 10.12 OF TITLE 10 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE ESTABLISHING PRIMA FACIE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN CITY STREETS – It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 749 amending Section 10.12.020 of Chapter 10.12 of Title 10 of the La Mirada Municipal Code establishing prima facie speed limits on certain City streets, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.2 Ordinance No. 749 Adjusting Speed Limits
